heading: Withholding
lead: Whenever the Administrator, after giving reasonable notice and opportunity for hearing to a recipient of financial assistance under this subchapter, finds that— the Administrator shall initiate such proceedings as are appropriate.

tree.text: the program or activity for which the grant or contract involved was made has been so changed that it no longer complies with this subchapter; or
in the operation of such program or activity there is failure to comply substantially with any provision of this subchapter;

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 5673 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1988, see section 7296(a) of Pub. L. 100–690, set out as an Effective Date of 1988 Amendment note under section 11101 of this title.
